requirements.text: Enable students to manage their borrowing and room bookings online
Automate the fine process to reduce manual workload
Provide librarians with enhanced tools for inventory management
Integrate seamlessly with the university's single sign-on
Ensure compliance with GDPR regarding student data
Students should be able to search the library catalog in real-time
Students should have the ability to borrow, return, and renew items online
Students need to reserve study rooms by selecting date, time slot, and room capacity
Students should be able to view their current loans, check due dates, and see outstanding fines
Automated email reminders for due dates and notifications regarding fines should be implemented
Calculate fines based on a configurable daily rate for overdue items
Automatically apply incurred fines to the student's account and update their outstanding fines balance in real-time
Notify students promptly when fines are applied via automated email notifications
Automatically place restrictions on a student's account if fines exceed a certain configurable threshold
Provide a user-friendly interface for librarians to manage inventory
Generate usage reports that track loan volumes over specific time periods
Provide reports on popular items to inform purchasing decisions
Provide room utilization metrics to understand booking frequency
Track fine revenue to assess the financial impact of fines
Ensure personal data is securely stored and accessible only to authorized library staff
Establish clear data retention policies for borrowing history and fine records
Inform students of their rights regarding their data
Obtain consent from students before collecting or processing their data
Ensure compliance of data shared with third-party vendors with GDPR
